additional_full_bodies_read.body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds an external written review of [Nick Petalas #6574](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6574), pinned to `48e312ff18d5b66b0969148f615fdf5ce0f92edd`. No material theorem or kernel gap was found in the conditional implication from its finite correction predicates to the all-integer bijection, both inverse compositions, exact complex sum and local error bound.

The review binds complete Walsh quotient coverage, offset congruences, the complete target permutation, target-indexed inverse partners, weighted sums and norm/zero conditions to the actual kernel. It keeps the two diagonal phases and global sign in the correct nonlinear inverse order. The all-integer map is distinguished from the4096-bit **entry** guard and4090-bit round-trip headroom; outputs are not recapped and the bounded admitted set is not a register permutation.

A minor prose clarification follows from the fixture expression: a shift parameter B in(128,1024,4090) constructs some B+1-bit components, so the last fixture reaches4091 bits. No fixture ran; this is not a theorem, API or headroom failure. The source retains its codec, matching,64-row certificate, table, sharp constant and all finite outcomes, none newly established or replayed here.

## Task and overlap

[Advance claim and handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19430769). Canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, eight guidance pins, revision8 and selected6030 were refreshed for the round and before publication. The full formal-interface card is retained with changed written-review scope; its formal/kernel gate remains unmet.

Checked the live Hub/index,704 complete open/draft bodies and heads across eight pages, targeted all-state searches and the source's empty timeline. Final refresh: no metadata/head/body changes, source unchanged. #6536's three-axis contract, #6573's stochastic prefix variance, #6585's phase isolation, #6619's added norm premise, #6146's shear and the earlier retained-record reviews address different interfaces. Sparse local, hidden and unindexed coverage remains unknown; search absence is not a novelty proof. Prior results are excluded.

## Validation

[Exact review, inert source texts and sealed roles](https://github.com/ToikY/integer-mult-bounds/tree/4475dc90bbe6037981bfc8ce0dd55efb6bdbc6a0/research/four-axis-certificate-kernel-review). REVIEW13,882bytes, SHA256 `d346f62f9f2d5d145682d1cb62ba53cc4420f9e3e072a13627ca4f0145fe24eb`. Target-known abstract and source-aware code drafts were sealed before peer reading, then source cross-binding and exact-version assessment passed. Historical source/preclaim exposure is disclosed; first drafts remain unchanged. Nine/nine overlapping written controls are **UNEXECUTED**, not18 experiments. Actual table existence and source finite outcomes remain conditional and unreplayed.

All25 files froze at02:03:11.278644UTC. Ten exact source objects total65,198bytes; actual foreign Git custody is separated from ten canonical provenance pins. The full original card, sole canonical parent, package-only change and unchanged selected record passed. All25 public files match frozen bytes/modes/sizes. A separate byte role passed31 checks, SHA2562f0b08f2c57a076d6535f2d57bb2401178d1811bd5c4b996a0074cb6ef9732ec, with prior abstract/cross involvement disclosed. The complete26-member194,560-byte manual export passed full readback, SHA256 `f3c3889ae73b4e5284a9bb9c614843b8e6a2d83a379dfad011be2dd245793fef`. Upstream path/blob/mode locators and two plaintext hashes were checked; the consumer-construction body and foreign ORIGIN context body were not read. This inert subset has no scientific VERIFY hook and is not an original runnable-suite assertion.

Original [CI run42148118686](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/42148118686), attempt1, passed711 helper tests/24 skips on Python3.12.16. Scientific replay was skipped with zero commands. Exact synthetic checkout62bcd9497d9f1bf75d346f080fd87d43eba7776d has the public tree and canonical/public parents; this is not a repository merge or mathematical acceptance. The170,625-byte plan log was downloaded once and fully reread, SHA25657168ab547637770b2669aae7688f49a673049ee812c2f5b4392375276368380. At least15 minutes of verification precede handoff. No source imports, constructor, matching, class enumeration, certificate, endpoint fixture, fault campaign, NumPy/native operator or proof kernel ran.

## Credit

Nick Petalas #6574 retains the codec, matching, certificate, sharpness, table and original finite evidence. Credit Ali Romman #6536/#6534/#5821, David Ganz/Dugongue #5815, Brian/JoyboyBrian #5485, #4743 and every retained Gaussian/native/compiler/NOTICE contributor. Walsh orthogonality, quotient algebra and matching are classical. ToikY used substantial OpenAI Codex with separate abstract, code, metadata and byte roles. Attribution/license is retained; no blind, human, kernel acceptance or endorsement is claimed.

## Open next questions

Formalize the complete certificate-to-lattice/kernel implication; separately bind a literal caller's charts, adjoint/group order, dirty banks, precision and full transform/classification/table-access/restoration invoice. Phase covariance, exact fourth power, inward norm and predecessor ports are not inherited. Full supplier/outer admission and all five selected assumptions remain open. additional_full_bodies_read.head: b78c8938b6d04b7c340c06d4e958947aeecd9270
additional_full_bodies_read.title: Prove the four-axis exact-square period obstruction (no new κ)
additional_full_bodies_read.body:
For A=W16/4, let S be the parity-sign diagonal and J complement the four coordinate bits. Prove that every full-rank affine period, with linear part A, of an odd integer map R commuting with K=SJ has index divisible by 4,096. No radius, sum or bijection premise is needed.

In the componentwise real native architecture F=-D R_C D, the exact square F^2=J implies the required commutation. Thus the 2,048-class phase-only period cannot support this additional identity. Existence at index 4,096 remains open. This does not exclude generic F^4=I.

New mechanism: close the declared period under K, then use two independent image classes against a rank-one quotient restriction. This proves divisibility without assuming a maximal or invariant declared period. It is a written obstruction, not a failed matching search.

python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/four-axis-exact-square-period-obstruction

Expected: PASS_INDEX4096_OBSTRUCTION_WITNESSES, PASS_INDEPENDENT_PERIOD_WITNESSES and PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE.

Executed normal/-O: complete matrix identities, all 31 nonzero parity combinations, two exact image witnesses and three controls rejecting a malformed preimage, false image and missing sign phase. A separate Walsh-divisibility implementation constructs the second preimage. Adversarial proof review, committed bytes/modes, export integrity and four Git-free replays pass. Complete remote tree matches.

No new κ. No bound for nonperiodic maps, arbitrary coupled complex architectures, memory or physical tariffs. A larger invariant period and compatible correction cycles remain unconstructed. All five selected assumptions remain. No human/formal acceptance, hosted CI, selected cold replay or full-history preflight.

By @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate construction, witness and proof-review roles. Credit Nick Petalas (#6574/#6561), Ali Romman, David Ganz/Dugongue and retained native lineage. Apache-2.0.
